comun.sin_periodos: No periods yet: they open with the farm's first accounting event.
comun.sin_coincidencias_detalle: Change the search or remove a filter to see more records.
comun.sin_acceso_periodos: Your role cannot view accounting periods: ask for access to the period close to see this section.

col.valor_neto: Fair value less costs to sell

motivo.SIN_PRECIO: The species has no current market price.
motivo.SIN_MAGNITUD: The asset has no recorded weight or count.
motivo.SIN_COSTOS_VENTA: The species has no costs to sell configured.
motivo.VALOR_NETO_NO_POSITIVO: Costs to sell equal or exceed the fair value.

config.descripcion: Close frequency, how each species is measured, its costs to sell and the accounts for each accounting event.
config.tipo_cierre_ayuda: The change applies to periods opened from now on; open periods keep their frequency.
config.umbral_ayuda: A new price further than this from the current one asks for confirmation.
config.umbral_invalido: Enter a percentage greater than 0 and up to 1000.
config.especies_ayuda: Each species is measured per kilogram or per head. Costs to sell are the share of gross value it costs to sell the asset. Useful life is only used when the species has no market price.
config.clasificacion_requerida: Choose whether the species is bearer or consumable.
config.vida_invalida: Useful life must be a whole number of months.
config.matriz_ayuda: Pair of ledger accounts for each event. A mapping for a species or cost type overrides the general one.
config.matriz_vacia: No accounts mapped yet. Without them the close cannot produce the voucher.
config.cuentas_iguales: Debit and credit accounts must differ.
config.pendientes_detalle: Map the accounts for their event: the lines complete themselves and the close becomes available.

precios.descripcion: Repository of market prices by species with their source and evidence. A price is never edited: it is corrected by recording a new one.
precios.registrar_ayuda: Source priority is active market, then UPRA, and last the Accountant's documented estimate.
precios.corregir_ayuda: The correction is a new price that replaces the previous one from its effective date.
precios.vacio_detalle: Record each species' market price to recognize and measure its assets at fair value.
precios.sin_productos: The species has no active production metrics.
precios.precio_invalido: Enter a price greater than zero.
precios.fuente_ayuda: Use an estimate only when there is no active-market or UPRA price.
precios.vigencia_ayuda: A future date schedules the price.
precios.vencimiento_invalido: Expiry must be after the effective date.
precios.justificacion_ayuda: Why there is no market price and which comparables you used (at least 50 characters).
precios.justificacion_estimada: Document the estimate with at least 50 characters.
precios.desviacion_titulo: The price deviates a lot from the current one
precios.aviso_titulo: Inputs for the fair value calculation
precios.aviso_detalle: Prices in this repository feed the fair value calculation; they are not the asset's carrying amount.
precios.sin_vigente_titulo_one: {{count}} species without a current reference price
precios.sin_vigente_titulo_other: {{count}} species without a current reference price
precios.sin_vigente_detalle: {{especies}}. Their assets cannot be revalued at close without authorization: record a new price.

recon.descripcion: Biological assets enter the books at fair value less costs to sell (IAS 41 ¶10-12). If the species has no price, they are measured at cost.
recon.vacio_detalle: Every registered asset already has its initial recognition.
recon.modal_ayuda: Review the calculation before confirming. The difference between initial value and acquisition cost goes to profit or loss for the period.
recon.sin_hechos: This recognition produces no gain or loss.
recon.costos_invalidos: Costs must be numbers equal to or greater than zero.
recon.justificacion: Justification and support for the costs
recon.justificacion_corta: Justify the asset-specific costs with at least 20 characters.
recon.aviso_pendientes_detalle: Review the calculation the system proposes and confirm it so the asset enters the books.

valor.vacio_detalle: Confirm the assets' initial recognition to start measuring them.
valor.sin_titular: The farm has no tax holder
valor.simulacion_ayuda: This is only a query: it creates no entries and does not change the carrying amount.
valor.modelo_costo_ayuda: The asset is measured at cost because its species had no market price at recognition. Once a price exists it must move to fair value.
valor.cambio_ok: The asset is now measured at fair value.
valor.deterioro_ayuda: Impairment reduces the carrying amount because of a health event that affected the asset.
valor.evento_sanitario_ayuda: Choose the asset's health event that caused the impairment.
valor.deterioro_incompleto: Enter the health event, an impact greater than zero and a justification of at least 30 characters.
valor.mediciones_ayuda: The total change is split into the biological transformation part and the market price part.
valor.sin_lineas: The asset has no entry lines.
valor.revertir_ayuda: Posts the mirror entry. Only possible if the asset has no later measurements or costs.
valor.simulacion_invalida: The asset's fair value could not be calculated.
valor.sin_eventos_sanitarios: The asset has no health events recorded in Biological assets.

costos.descripcion: Labor, services and purchases attributable to the assets. Feed and medicine consumption arrive automatically from Supplies.
costos.registrar_ayuda: A maintenance cost is a period expense. An investment is only capitalized on assets measured at cost.
costos.vacio_detalle: Record here the costs that do not come from Supplies.
costos.clasificar_ayuda: State the cost's nature and why: it decides whether it is an expense, an investment or a cost to sell.
costos.naturaleza_ayuda: Leave as is unless the cost is an investment or a cost to sell.
costos.capitalizar_ayuda: Only for assets measured at cost; on a fair-value asset the investment is an expense.
costos.aviso_fuente_unica: This invoice reaches the books through the SIGAB export: do not enter it manually in the accounting system.
costos.monto_invalido: Enter an amount greater than zero.
costos.reparto_minimo: Choose at least two assets to allocate the cost.
costos.justificacion_requerida: This cost requires a justification of at least 10 characters.
costos.proveedor_incompleto: Fill in the tax ID (6 to 15 digits), check digit, legal name, invoice number and date.
costos.descripcion_periodo: Costs of {{periodo}} classified by accounting nature. Feed and medicine consumption arrives automatically from Supplies.
costos.politica_detalle: Maintenance costs are expenses of the period in the income statement and do not change the asset's value. Costs to sell are deducted from fair value.
costos.pendientes_detalle: «Other» costs need you to declare their accounting nature before the close.
costos.ayuda_MANTENIMIENTO: Expense of the period in the income statement; does not change the asset's value.
costos.ayuda_VENTA: Deducted from fair value to reach the net value.
costos.ayuda_INVERSION: Capitalized only on assets measured at cost; otherwise it is an expense.

cierre.descripcion: The close measures assets with the last day's prices, creates the IAS 41 voucher by event and species, the income statement and the disclosure draft, and opens the next period.
cierre.ultimo_fallido: The last close attempt failed at step {{paso}}
cierre.excluir: Exclude them from this close's remeasurement
cierre.incluir_estimacion: Measure them with the last known price, flagged as an estimate
cierre.autorizar_lineas: I authorize excluding lines with incomplete traceability from the voucher (they move to the next period)
cierre.confirmar_detalle: You are about to close {{periodo}}. The period becomes immutable: events dated in it that arrive later are recorded in the next one.
cierre.siguiente_abierto: The next period has been opened.
cierre.sin_comprobantes: The close produced no vouchers (there were no accounting events).
cierre.comprobantes_al_cerrar: Vouchers are generated when the period closes.
cierre.lineas_ayuda: Each line must trace back to its evidence: the event, reading or price that originated it.
cierre.sin_lineas: The period has no entry lines.
cierre.prevalidacion_ayuda: The system checks every part of the period before closing it.
cierre.check_reconocimientos_ok: No recognition proposals left to confirm.
cierre.check_reconocimientos_pend_one: {{count}} unconfirmed proposal: {{activos}}. Those assets are left out of the close.
cierre.check_reconocimientos_pend_other: {{count}} unconfirmed proposals: {{activos}}. Those assets are left out of the close.
cierre.check_precios_ok: Every species has a current price for revaluation.
cierre.check_precios_pend_one: {{count}} asset without a current price: {{activos}}. Decide below whether to exclude it or measure it with an estimate.
cierre.check_precios_pend_other: {{count}} assets without a current price: {{activos}}. Decide below whether to exclude them or measure them with an estimate.
cierre.check_trazabilidad_ok: Every line has a complete chain.
cierre.check_trazabilidad_pend_one: {{count}} line with an incomplete chain ({{hechos}}). It needs your authorization to be left out of the voucher.
cierre.check_trazabilidad_pend_other: {{count}} lines with an incomplete chain ({{hechos}}). They need your authorization to be left out of the voucher.
cierre.check_costos_ok: Every cost has an accounting nature.
cierre.requiere_autorizacion: Some preconditions are pending: you can close, but the affected assets and lines need your explicit authorization.
cierre.no_puede: The period cannot be closed until the blockers in the list are solved.
cierre.irreversible: Irreversible: the period closes and the next one opens.
cierre.sin_eslabones: The line has no recorded links yet.
cierre.check_anterior_ok: The holder's previous period is already closed.
cierre.check_cuentas_ok: Every entry line has a debit and credit account.
cierre.check_suministros_ok: All Supplies consumption is already in the period costs.

cot.descripcion: Sale offers for assets with their reference fair value at quoting time.
cot.sin_efecto: Quotes have no accounting effect: they do not change asset values or create entries.
cot.vacio_detalle: Record a quote to compare the offered value with the fair value.
cot.valor_invalido: Enter a value greater than zero.
cot.justificacion_requerida: Justify the change with at least 10 characters.

er.descripcion: Gains and losses on biological assets for the period, with maintenance costs as expenses.
er.vacio_detalle: It is produced when the period closes, or you can generate it now to review it.
er.descarga_aprobado: Download becomes available once the statement is approved.
er.excluidos_detalle_one: {{count}} asset was excluded from remeasurement for lack of a price.
er.excluidos_detalle_other: {{count}} assets were excluded from remeasurement for lack of a price.
er.descripcion_periodo: Gains and losses of the biological assets in {{periodo}}, with maintenance costs as expenses.
er.solo_cerrados: Income statements are generated only for closed periods
er.solo_cerrados_detalle: Close the period to generate its statement. It includes the income and expense breakdown IAS 41 requires.
er.desglose_detalle: Each version separates income and expenses by recognition, transformation, price, produce and costs.
er.filtros_ayuda: Filters narrow the scope of the statement. Without filters, it is the consolidated one.

rev.descripcion: Disclosures for the closed period: reconciliation, split of gains, methods, commitments and risks.
rev.vacio_detalle: The close creates the first draft version.
rev.rechazar_ayuda: State what needs to be corrected. You can then generate a new version.
rev.generar_ayuda: Record the period's commitments and pledged assets, or declare there are none.
rev.sin_novedad: I declare there are no commitments or pledged assets in the period.
rev.justificacion_ayuda: Required if the system detects differences between sources (at least 20 characters).
rev.filas_incompletas: Fill in each commitment's description and each pledge's asset and lender.
rev.declare_o_registre: Record at least one commitment or pledge, or tick the declaration.
rev.datos_insuficientes: Not enough data for this section.

s.parr_40_ganancias_perdidas: Gain or loss for the period (¶40)
s.parr_51_separacion_precio_transformacion: Split between price and biological transformation (¶51)

rev.descripcion_periodo: Disclosures for {{periodo}}: reconciliation, split of gains, methods, commitments and risks.
rev.solo_cerrados: Disclosures are generated for closed periods
rev.solo_cerrados_detalle: The period close creates the first draft version; afterwards you can generate new versions.
rev.descarga_aprobado: Download is enabled once the report is approved.

aud.descripcion: Read-only record of every operation in the financial module, with its author, the amount affected and its integrity fingerprint.
aud.vacio_detalle: There are no audit events for the chosen period and filters.
aud.descripcion_periodo: Read-only record of the operations in {{periodo}}, with their author, the amount affected and their integrity fingerprint.

evento.RECONOCIMIENTO_BLOQUEADO_SIN_VALOR: Recognition blocked: no price or cost
evento.MEDICION_SIN_VARIACION: Measurement with no change in value
evento.ACTIVO_MARCADO_SIN_MERCADO: Asset without market price: cost model
evento.CALCULO_VALOR_RAZONABLE: Fair value less costs to sell calculated
evento.AJUSTE_MANUAL_COSTOS_VENTA: Manual adjustment of costs to sell

medicion.descripcion: Fair value of the recognized assets: each measurement separates growth from price changes (IAS 41 ¶12 and ¶51).
medicion.descripcion_periodo: Fair value of the recognized assets in {{periodo}}: each measurement separates growth from price changes (IAS 41 ¶12 and ¶51).
medicion.aviso_detalle: Every weighing, entry, write-off or harvest of the asset creates its measurement, and the close measures the whole period. «Measure now» processes pending events right away.
medicion.kpi_estimado_detalle: Measured with the last known price

calculo.titulo: Fair value less costs to sell
calculo.descripcion: Transport, commissions and transaction taxes are deducted from gross fair value to reach the recorded value (IAS 41 ¶12).
calculo.activo_ayuda: Choose an asset to see its current market price and the full calculation. Nothing is recorded.
calculo.vacio_detalle: Calculations are recorded with every recognition, measurement or harvest in the period.

productos.descripcion: Produce recognized at the point of harvest at fair value less costs to sell (IAS 41 ¶13). That value is its inventory cost.
productos.descripcion_periodo: Produce recognized in {{periodo}} at the point of harvest at fair value less costs to sell (IAS 41 ¶13). That value is its inventory cost.
productos.nota_titulo: Maintenance costs are not deducted from produce
productos.nota_detalle: Feed, medicine and labor are already expenses of the period they occurred in. Harvests are recorded as a production event in Biological assets and recognized here once processed.
productos.kpi_consumo_detalle: The asset itself is the produce
productos.vacio_titulo: No agricultural produce in the period
productos.vacio_detalle: When a harvest is recorded in Biological assets, it shows up here once events are processed.
productos.pendientes_ayuda: They are missing the market price or the selling costs of the produce. Once the price is recorded in Market prices or the costs in Accounting settings, process the events and they will be recognised; if no costs are configured, you can also enter them here.
productos.ingresar_costos_aria: Enter the selling costs of {{producto}} from {{activo}}
productos.costos_ayuda: Harvest of {{cantidad}} {{unidad}}. Enter the selling costs of the produce in COP; empty ones are not deducted.
productos.costos_falta: Enter at least one selling cost for the produce.

sin_mercado.descripcion: Assets measured at cost because their species had no reliable market price when recognized (IAS 41 ¶30), and assets measured with an estimated price.
sin_mercado.aviso_titulo: An asset can only enter at cost on initial recognition
sin_mercado.aviso_detalle: One already measured at fair value stays that way (IAS 41 ¶31): if its species loses its current price, it is measured with the last known price flagged as an estimate. To leave cost, record a price for the species.
sin_mercado.pasar_vr_titulo_one: {{count}} asset at cost already has a market price
sin_mercado.pasar_vr_titulo_other: {{count}} assets at cost already have a market price
sin_mercado.pasar_vr_detalle: The standard requires measuring them at fair value: {{activos}}. Open them and use «Move to fair value».
sin_mercado.kpi_estimados_detalle: At fair value with the last known price
sin_mercado.razon_inicial: No market price for the species when recognized
sin_mercado.razon_estimado: The species has no current price: the last known one is used
sin_mercado.ya_hay_precio: The species already has a current price: it must move to fair value
sin_mercado.vacio_titulo: Every asset has a market price
sin_mercado.vacio_detalle: There are no assets measured at cost or with an estimated price.

variaciones.descripcion: Gains and losses from biological transformation and from market price (IAS 41 ¶26 and ¶51).
variaciones.descripcion_periodo: Gains and losses in {{periodo}} from biological transformation and from market price (IAS 41 ¶26 and ¶51).
variaciones.kpi_pendientes_detalle: To verify or with an incomplete chain
variaciones.resumen_ayuda: Changes are recognized in profit or loss for the period in which they arise (IAS 41 ¶26).
variaciones.vacio_detalle: They appear when a measurement changes an asset's fair value.

traza.descripcion: Chain of custody of every entry line, from the physical data to the voucher.
traza.descripcion_periodo: Chain of custody of every entry line in {{periodo}}, from the physical data to the voucher.
traza.aviso_titulo: Only lines with a verified chain enter the closing voucher
traza.aviso_detalle: Lines with an incomplete chain stay out until verification is complete or until you authorize their exclusion at close.
traza.incompletas_one: {{count}} line has an incomplete chain of custody
traza.incompletas_other: {{count}} lines have an incomplete chain of custody
traza.incompletas_detalle: Open its chain to see which link is missing.
